features.title: Automatic meeting cancellation
features.benefit: Automatically cancel a participant's meetings and bookings when they become inactive, and meetings they started if they move to a category without meetings.
features.what: Organisers can switch on automatic cancellation of a participant's confirmed, incoming and pending meetings, session bookings and exhibitor events if they become inactive, and of meetings they began if moved to a category without meetings.
features.detail: Organisers can switch on automatic cancellation of confirmed, incoming and pending meetings, session bookings and exhibitor events when a participant's status is no longer active, and of meetings a user started when they move to a category that does not allow meetings, with the reason stated.

features.title: Meeting confirmation and location rules
features.benefit: Auto-confirm meetings for chosen participant categories and keep meeting locations accurate once the in-person event ends.
features.what: Meeting auto-confirmation can be switched on per participant category. After the last in-person slot, requests offer only online meetings, and requesters type an 'other' location when no preset options exist.
features.detail: Meeting auto-confirmation can be switched on per participant category. After the last in-person slot, requests offer only online meetings, and when 'other location' is allowed without preset options, requesters type the location themselves.

features.what: Calendar meeting cards show the other party and location first, then time and title. Matchmaking cards show company name. Admin meeting pages link participants to their profiles, and contact sharing settings sit in three groups.
features.detail: Calendar meeting cards now show the other party and location first, then time and title. Matchmaking cards show the participant's company name. In the admin meeting management pages, participant photos and names link to their edit pages, and contact sharing settings are grouped into three labelled sections.

features.detail: The rescheduling time grid now opens on the meeting's current date with its time preselected. A 'Disallow meeting reschedule for' setting hides the Reschedule button on meeting cards for selected roles and categories, on web and in the app.

features.detail: Speakers' and moderators' calendars are blocked during their sessions and exhibitor events for meeting requests and confirmations. Slot-blocking exhibitor events can no longer be booked over confirmed meetings, blocked time, other blocking events or speaker duties.

features.detail: Blocked time is now a schedule item with its own cards and edit and delete actions, managed from the Schedule and Team Schedule pages through an 'Add blocked time' pop-up. features.title: Round table numbering
features.benefit: Give every round table in a session a unique number that never shifts.
features.what: Round table numbers run in one continuous sequence across all topics in a session, so each table has a unique number. New tables take the smallest free number.
features.detail: Table numbers run in one sequence across all topics in a session; new tables take the smallest free number.
stories: Round tables. Table numbers across all topics

features.title: Matchmaking and booking improvements
features.benefit: Control which categories shape matchmaking and spot every available time slot when booking.
features.what: Organisers can set each parent category to be included in, excluded from or strictly applied in the new matchmaking. The meeting time picker shows a scroll hint so users can see more time slots below.
features.detail: Organisers can set each parent category to be included in, excluded from or strictly applied in matchmaking, and the meeting time picker now shows a scroll hint so users see that more slots are available below.
stories: Matchmaking Improvements. Precise Matchmaking
Timepicker. Scroll Hint

features.title: Meeting programme attendance tracking
features.benefit: Record completed meetings by badge or QR scan and flag no-shows as an organiser or participant.
features.what: Meeting programme meetings are marked completed when the table QR code or the other person's badge is scanned. Organisers and participants can record a no-show, and ratings open in the app once final schedules are received.
features.detail: Meeting programme meetings can be completed by QR or badge scan, and both organisers and participants can mark a no-show. Ratings open in the app once final schedules are received.
stories: MP || FE Meeting Completion via QR & Badge Scan

features.title: Meeting programme improvements
features.benefit: Run meeting programmes with a simpler participant view, split voting phases, early exhibitor access and more organiser control.
features.what: Meeting programmes have split voting phases, restructured tabs and one schedule list, and exhibitors can get early access to set team roles. Users can sort matches; organisers can delete meetings, limit timeslots and turn off notifications.
features.detail: Voting phases were split and tabs restructured, meeting blocks combine into one schedule list, and exhibitors can get early access. Users can sort matches in the relevance and opt-in phases, and organisers gained manual meeting deletion, timeslot blocking limits, optional conditions for team members and a switch to disable notifications; deleted users are removed.

features.title: Round table seating controls
features.benefit: Add people to tables after final schedules and set a limit on the number of tables.
features.what: Organisers can add, remove and move people between round tables after the final schedule is sent, and set a limit on the number of tables per session. Users deleted from the platform are removed from sessions.
features.detail: Organisers can add users to a table after the final schedule is sent and define a tables limit, and deleted users are removed from sessions.

features.title: Speed networking push notifications
features.benefit: Receive opt-in speed networking updates as push notifications on iOS and Android.
features.what: The iOS and Android apps send push notifications for opt-in speed networking, such as being added or removed, schedules being ready and changes, according to each person's role.
features.detail: Push notifications for opt-in speed networking were set up in the iOS and Android apps.
stories: Set up push notifications for Speed Networking 2 in iOS and Android

features.title: Meeting notes, private and AI
features.benefit: Keep private notes on every meeting, and get AI meeting notes in the language the meeting was held in.
features.what: Attendees can add a private note when requesting a meeting or from their schedule, on web and in the app, and find all notes in one My Notes panel. AI meeting notes are produced in the meeting language, with one shared action list.
features.detail: Attendees add a private note when requesting a meeting or from their schedule, on web and in the app, and find every note in one My Notes panel. AI meeting notes are produced in the meeting language, with one shared list of action points for all participants.
stories: Generate outputs in the meeting language

features.title: Meeting setup improvements
features.benefit: Set up matchmaking categories faster and get improved table meeting setup and meeting cards in the app.
features.what: Selecting a parent category in Networking & Matchmaking selects all of its child categories. In the app, meetings created by organisers show as confirmed and marked as such, and table meetings are booked with zone and table selection.
features.detail: Selecting a parent category in Networking & Matchmaking now selects all its child categories. The app gained improvements to table meeting setup and meeting cards.
stories: Networking & Matchmaking: Select All Child Categories When Parent is Selected
Table meeting setup and meeting cards improvements in app

features.title: Centralised meeting formats admin
features.benefit: Manage speed networking, meeting programmes, concierge meetings, round tables and exhibitor events from one place.
features.what: A Meeting Formats area in the admin panel holds speed networking, meeting programmes and concierge meetings, each with its own email templates. Round tables and exhibitor events have their own sections there, and each format has a switch.
features.detail: Module management for meeting formats was restructured, with a central area for speed networking, meeting programmes and concierge meetings. Email templates for every format are managed there, round tables are managed independently, and exhibitor events management was enhanced.
stories: Restructure Module Management for Meeting Format

features.title: Smarter meeting generation
features.benefit: Get fuller, fairer generated schedules for speed networking and meeting programmes.
features.what: Meeting generation for speed networking and meeting programmes spreads meetings more evenly, can pool likes across an exhibitor's team, can count one-sided likes as mutual for chosen roles, and can add pairs where no likes exist.
features.detail: Meetings are spread more evenly across participants, likes can be pooled across an exhibitor's team, one-sided likes can count as mutual for chosen role directions, and extra pairs can be generated where no likes exist. Invalid input now returns an error rather than creating meetings in blocked slots, and sponsored limits no longer block organiser-created meetings.

features.title: AI meeting notes add-on
features.benefit: Offer AI meeting notes to exhibitors as a paid Lead Capture Pro add-on they can buy themselves.
features.what: Organisers can offer AI meeting notes as a Lead Capture Pro add-on and set its price in the event's payment currency. Exhibitors see and buy it on their Lead Capture Pro page, which turns on AI transcription for their whole team.
features.detail: Organisers enable AI meeting notes as a Lead Capture Pro add-on and set its price in the event's payment currency. Exhibitors see and buy it on the Lead Capture Pro page, unlocking AI transcription for their whole team.

features.title: Meeting management improvements
features.benefit: Open Bulk Respond without waiting for large teams to load, and restrict meetings with exhibitors without teams in the app.
features.what: Bulk Respond opens straight away whatever the team size and refreshes after changes are applied. The mobile app follows the setting that restricts meetings with exhibitors who have no team members, as the web does.
features.detail: Bulk Respond now opens instantly regardless of team size and refreshes after changes are applied. The mobile app respects the setting that restricts meetings with exhibitors who have no team members.
stories: Bulk respond: remove full-team prefetch and pre-Apply sweep in favor of a post-apply grid refetch
Backend endpoint with "Restrict meetings" setting

features.title: Round table waitlist replacement
features.benefit: More reliable waitlist replacement when round table seats are freed.
features.what: When a round table seat is freed, eligible waitlist candidates are now worked out within matching itself: applicants not already invited to a seat in any generation or earlier replacement.
features.detail: Eligible waitlist candidates for a freed round table seat are now worked out within matching itself: applicants who have not already been invited to a seat in any generation or earlier replacement. This removes an error-prone step.
stories: Improve waitlist replacement to auto-detect available candidates
